notes.title: Thistlemine - Update Live!
notes.content:
Fixed some strange checkpoint behaviour starting from [spoiler]Astr Underground[/spoiler] up to the end of the game.
Fixed a missing collision tile in the [spoiler]Astr Undeground[/spoiler]
Fixed certain Glass Eye text and fixed missing quicksave checkpoints

notes.title: Update live with several fixes!
notes.content:
Fixed [spoiler]Funeral Bouquet[/spoiler] not working while playing in Japanese.
 Fixed missing Japanese text for [spoiler]Armless[/spoiler] at the Rifts, also changed her stats a bit. (May or may not cause a character data desync bug for existing saves. If the data desync has occurred with a blank character joining the party at the end of [spoiler]Alternate Cosmos, please use a Charged Rock Hammer to avoid a potential softlock.[/spoiler]). Old Saves located in the Rifts may have a slightly bugged [spoiler]Armless[/spoiler]. This can be fixed by simply restarting Rifts.
 Added an extra turn to [spoiler]Marjorie[/spoiler], forced first action at the beginning of the battle.
 Portals at [spoiler]Somni's[/spoiler] checkpoint no longer take the player to Tulips.
 Portals at [spoiler]Cosmos Water Checkpoints[/spoiler] no longer lead to Tulips.
